title: Arduino Uno + SOS Morse Beacon (Digital Pin D7)
description: Construct and verify an Arduino-controlled SOS Morse distress beacon: D7 digital drive pin, 1k current-limiting resistor, red LED, and ground return rail.

steps.title: Place Current-Limiting Resistor
steps.instruction: Insert the 1k ohm resistor into rows E10 and E14.

hints.missing: Place the 1k ohm resistor on the board between holes E10 and E14.
hints.wrong_position: Move the resistor so its legs connect to rows E10 and E14.

steps.title: Place the LED in Series
steps.instruction: Insert the LED: Anode (longer leg) in E14, Cathode (shorter leg) in E18.

hints.missing: Insert the LED into holes E14 and E18.
hints.wrong_position: Check LED holes: long leg (anode) in E14, short leg (cathode) in E18.
hints.reversed: Reverse the LED: the longer leg (anode) must connect to the resistor at E14.

steps.title: Connect Arduino 5V to Power Rail
steps.instruction: Connect a red wire from Arduino 5V pin to the (+) power rail.

hints.missing: Connect a red wire from Arduino 5V pin to the (+) power rail.
hints.wrong_position: One end of the red wire must be in Arduino 5V, the other in the (+) rail.

steps.title: Connect Arduino GND to Ground Rail
steps.instruction: Connect a black wire from Arduino GND pin to the (-) ground rail.

hints.missing: Connect a black wire from Arduino GND pin to the (-) ground rail.
hints.wrong_position: One end of the black wire must be in Arduino GND, the other in the (-) rail.

steps.title: Connect Arduino D7 Control Signal
steps.instruction: Connect a signal wire (green or yellow) from Arduino digital pin D7 to breadboard row E10.

hints.missing: Connect a signal wire from Arduino pin D7 to row E10.
hints.wrong_position: Ensure one end is plugged into Arduino D7 and the other into row E10.

steps.title: Close Ground Return Loop
steps.instruction: Connect a jumper wire from row E18 to the breadboard (-) ground rail.

hints.missing: Connect a jumper wire from row E18 to the (-) ground rail.
hints.wrong_position: One end of the jumper must be in row E18, the other in the (-) ground rail.
